result.instructions: Technical support back office for a Guatemalan ISP. Look up subscriber accounts, read live link metrics, check whether a regional outage already explains a complaint, run diagnostics, and open or follow up support tickets. Always check list_outages before opening a ticket for a connectivity complaint: if a mass outage already covers the subscriber's region, the ETA is the answer and a new ticket only adds noise.

tools.name: lookup_account
tools.title: Look up a subscriber account
tools.description: Find a subscriber by account id or by phone number. Returns the plan, the account status and the service address. Exactly one of account_id or phone must be supplied.

phone.description: Phone number in any format; only digits are compared.

tools.name: check_service_status
tools.title: Check service status
tools.description: Read the current link state for one account: latency, packet loss and SNR. If a mass outage covers the account's region, it is reported here.

tools.name: list_outages
tools.title: List mass outages
tools.description: List mass outages with their cause and estimated time of repair. Filter by region, and by default only outages that are still active.

region.description: Restrict to one region. Omit for every region.

active_only.description: Only outages still in progress. Defaults to true.

tools.name: run_diagnostic
tools.title: Run a line diagnostic
tools.description: Run a diagnostic against a subscriber line and return the measurements together with a probable cause. ping measures reachability, speed measures throughput against the contracted plan, line reads the physical layer.

tools.name: open_ticket
tools.title: Open a support ticket
tools.description: Open a support ticket against an account and return its id. Check list_outages first: if a mass outage already covers the region, the ETA answers the complaint and a ticket is not needed.

description.description: What the subscriber reported, in their own terms.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.title: Read a ticket
tools.description: Read a ticket's current status, its history, and any scheduled visit.

tools.name: schedule_visit
tools.title: Schedule a technician visit
tools.description: Schedule a technician visit against an existing ticket. The date must not be in the past. Scheduling again reschedules the existing visit.
